desc: Characterize passing structures and collision model.
Discard old block-cut-tree/block_swap gadget as wrong.
Implement BFS distances dS,dT, buffer candidates, iterative Tarjan BCT, and per-block min-cost-flow cycle gadget; public samples 3/-1/4 pass.
Run built-in selftest (empty stdin) and report real `SELFTEST bad=N`; if N>0 dump the full first FAIL line.
Re-run selftest with denser graphs (extra edges up to 8); report bad count.
If a failure appears, identify the minimal counterexample and revise the exact model term (block gadget cost 2*(dS[x]+dT[y])+cyc_B(x,y) or buffer pen=2/4) that is wrong.
